chains.name: XRPL

This is real mainnet, real money, RLUSD not USDC (XRPL has no canonical USDC deployment) — an operator who enables it does so entirely at their own risk; we do not run, control, or monitor anyone's deployment

chains.name: Cardano Preprod

packs.name: cautious
packs.$description: Tight training wheels: tiny caps, everything above a cent needs a human, hair-trigger runaway freeze, spending pinned to the one live chain. Start every new agent fleet here.

packs.name: production
packs.$description: For fleets you already trust: higher throughput, approvals reserved for genuinely large spends, runaway guard still armed, spending pinned to the Base chains. Set alertWebhookUrl before using this one.

packs.name: standard
packs.$description: The shipped default: sensible caps, human sign-off on anything above $0.015, 10-attempts-in-10s runaway freeze.

packs.name: trading
packs.$description: For trading desks: tight per-trade caps, two approvers above the position threshold, a hair-trigger runaway freeze, and a UTC trading window (edit allowedHoursUTC to your session — shipped wide open so nothing surprises you on day one).

rails.name: x402 — simulated settlement
rails.note: real ECDSA + replay protection; settles locally on all 7 registered chains

rails.name: x402 v2 — live settlement
rails.note: real on-chain USDC/stablecoin settlement on every registry chain the configured facilitator supports (public facilitator: base-sepolia, solana-devnet, aptos-testnet, stellar-testnet, hedera-testnet, and XRPL mainnet today; CDP facilitator key unlocks EVM mainnets)

rails.name: NPCI UPI (Unified Agent Protocol / UPI Circle)
rails.note: India — governed today via /api/upi/evaluate; settlement is a slot: NPCI's agent protocol is not live and needs RBI approval. SpendVeto decides, it never initiates UPI

rails.name: EU SEPA (PSD2 Open Banking / PISP)
rails.note: Eurozone — governed today via /api/eu/evaluate (RTS Strong Customer Authentication exemptions, SEPA Direct Debit pre-notification); settlement is a slot: initiating a SEPA payment requires PISP authorisation under a national competent authority, which SpendVeto does not hold. SpendVeto decides, it never initiates SEPA

rails.name: UK Faster Payments (Open Banking / PISP)
rails.note: UK — governed today via /api/uk/evaluate (Confirmation of Payee, PSR APP fraud reimbursement exposure); settlement is a slot: initiating a Faster Payments transaction requires PISP authorisation from the FCA, which SpendVeto does not hold. SpendVeto decides, it never initiates Faster Payments

rails.name: Brazil Pix (Pix Automático / Open Finance)
rails.note: Brazil — governed today via /api/br/evaluate (BCB nighttime limit, Pix Automático scheduling and retry rules); settlement is a slot: initiating Pix requires registration as a BCB-regulated participant, which SpendVeto does not hold. SpendVeto decides, it never initiates Pix

rails.name: US ACH (Nacha Operating Rules)
rails.note: United States — governed today via /api/us/evaluate (Nacha WEB debit account validation, Regulation E consumer-authorization rules); settlement is a slot: originating an ACH entry requires an Originating Depository Financial Institution relationship, which SpendVeto does not hold. SpendVeto decides, it never originates ACH entries

rails.name: Safe{Wallet} AllowanceModule
rails.note: on-chain-enforced spend caps via Safe's audited AllowanceModule — real call path implemented, gated behind SAFE_ADDRESS/ALLOWANCE_MODULE_ADDRESS config; see docs/safe-allowance.md
